summary: Aquaron Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its trust agreement and the issuance of a promissory note to facilitate its pending business combination with HUTURE Ltd. The trust amendment permits up to twelve monthly extensions from May 6, 2026 to May 6, 2027, requiring $0.033 per public share deposit per extension. A $4,000 unsecured promissory note was issued to HUTURE, convertible at $10.00 per unit, payable upon business combination completion. The Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation was filed to authorize these actions. The SPAC must complete its de-SPAC transaction by the Extended Date or liquidate. Watch stockholder redemptions and regulatory clearance for risk-arb spread.
